text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing—we happened to pass by an event venue
hosting a "Books & Chocolate Exhibition."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A chocolate event of all things...? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "LCC"... "Where" are the two of them?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...!
Admire Groove and her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, Still in Love
...no.
choice_data_list: Did you get separated from those two?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe failed exploration.
Places with large crowds have... severe 'noise.'"
choice_data_list: Alv, let's help look for them together

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove too...? ..."Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I entered the event booth to look for it.
There, chocolates themed around various genres
of books were being sold.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...This scent is far too sweet—
Let's find those two quickly.
choice_data_list: Where should we start searching— wait, Alv?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove advances without hesitation. Where she arrives is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"‘Historical Fiction Booth’.
...Ah."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Uni-san! Th-Thank goodness...!
I'm sorry, my phone had no service
and I didn't know what to do...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that Alv-san
brought Universe-san all the way here...?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... "APPR".
Neo Universe will give a "thank you".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Nice work figuring out where those two were.
So you figured out where those two were, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...There's no need to even hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san prefers heroic epics.
Universe-san prefers sci-fi and science-related topics.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still-san likes romance novels—and also
the historical novels the three of us often get excited about.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If they got separated... they'd probably move to
a booth with common ground where they could reunite
with the others, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: We just happen to bump into each other in the library often when studying.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You're right... Whenever I go to read, I often see the three of you there...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it... I found myself keeping track of the books Alve-san reads, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Aside from reference and technical books...
I see you also like photo albums of nature and animals.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...!
That's not—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Their seats, their books... The four of them were always "DIFF."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"But... that time is a 'precious' connect.
'Myutefu'."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I, too, feel that this is irreplaceable time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't particularly—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Alv-san!
Please let me thank you for today.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Just earlier, I found some low-sugar chocolate that's perfect for studying.
Would you like a box...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need any thanks.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't say that... even just a little...!
Some of them are individually wrapped, so couldn't we share...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Plus, even if it's not chocolate,
they had event-exclusive stationery too...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Neo Universe and the others 'AWAK' with Admire Groove. ...Let's go."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... "Melting Rich Love Chocolate".
How utterly irresistible... I'll take one, please.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Chocolates modeled after celestial bodies?
..."The Big Bang."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Usually, it's "HAF" with Zenno Rob Roy.
Today... the four of us will do "QTR."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That chocolate bar bookmark is so stylish.
The mint chocolate feels very Alv-san, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Something like this... is sheer decadence after all.
choice_data_list: (You say that, but you're still not going home.)
(You say that, but you're still not going home.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Something like this... is sheer decadence after all.
choice_data_list: (You say that, but you're still not going home.)
(You say that, but you're still not going home.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even she seemed hesitant to reject an offer made with pure, genuine goodwill.
choice_data_list: (It's fine for her to have some downtime like this once in a while.)
(It's nice for her to have some downtime like this once in a while.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...What have you been grinning about this whole time?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though pierced by an icy glare, the smile on their cheeks refused to fade.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Then, I will also—
choice_data_list: Alv, you should enjoy yourself a little more

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
P-Please do...! Even just a little bit!
Opportunities like this are so rare...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sii-knock.
...Want to have more 'fun'.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*
Just a tiny bit, okay?
